card.name: Inside brand names and codes
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of capitalized brand names split into parts (e.g. ENT-REST-O, SOLI-QU-A), and of hex color codes or abbreviations like b.i.d. The next piece is usually a short ending that finishes the name or code.

modes.label: Brand drug names
modes.description: Partway through an all-caps brand name in a label, just before its final letters.
modes.example: discontinue ENT<<REST>>O as soon as possible.

modes.label: Hex color codes
modes.description: Inside a hex color string after a # sign.
modes.example: add 1px stroke to it of color #138<<eb>>f.

modes.label: Dosing abbreviations and codes
modes.description: Inside dotted abbreviations or coded identifiers.
modes.example: may be increased to 50 mg b<<.i>>.d. or t.i.d.
